phases.title: Current System Audit
phases.objective: Map exactly what current Agentic Discipline already solves; avoid rebuilding working capabilities.

phases.title: Domain Kernel
phases.objective: Define stable entities, IDs, lifecycle, provenance, confidence, authority, versions, and typed edges.

phases.title: Persistence Layer
phases.objective: Implement local transactional persistence with migrations and optimistic concurrency.

phases.title: Knowledge Query Layer
phases.objective: Provide current/historical graph traversal and traceability queries.

phases.title: Discovery Coverage Engine
phases.objective: Measure repository understanding and prevent false claims of full inspection.

phases.title: Project Adoption Engine
phases.objective: Safely bootstrap Agentic Discipline 2.0 into an existing project.

phases.title: Claim Reconciliation
phases.objective: Convert raw evidence into claims and canonical knowledge without silent conflict loss.

phases.title: Plan Intelligence
phases.objective: Audit plans and project state for completeness, consistency, testability, and autonomy readiness.

phases.title: Readiness Gate
phases.objective: Return READY, READY_WITH_MANAGED_UNCERTAINTY, or BLOCKED with reasons.

phases.title: Task Contracts
phases.objective: Turn approved work into transferable, independently verifiable task contracts.

phases.title: Execution Graph
phases.objective: Model dependencies, blockers, states, and revalidation.

phases.title: Context Engine
phases.objective: Assemble minimum sufficient context with explicit budgets.

phases.title: Continuity Engine
phases.objective: Persist checkpoints and resume state independently from chat history.

phases.title: Evidence Freshness
phases.objective: Bind evidence to code and knowledge versions and invalidate stale proof.

phases.title: Agent Registry
phases.objective: Track workers, capabilities, sessions, and identity.

phases.title: Leases
phases.objective: Coordinate task ownership with expiry and recovery.

phases.title: Workspace Isolation
phases.objective: Provision worktrees/branches/sandboxes for parallel workers.

phases.title: Parallel Safety
phases.objective: Detect semantic overlap before concurrent execution.

phases.title: Integration Gate
phases.objective: Revalidate parallel work before merge into baseline.

phases.title: Continuous Reconciliation
phases.objective: Detect external/manual changes and update affected knowledge.

phases.title: Evolution Hygiene
phases.objective: Manage deprecations, temporary artifacts, replacements, and semantic garbage collection.

phases.title: Governance and Budgets
phases.objective: Apply permissions, protected actions, secret boundaries, and bounded autonomy.

phases.title: Observability
phases.objective: Provide reconstructable timelines for tasks, agents, evidence, and knowledge mutations.

phases.title: MCP Interface
phases.objective: Expose model-agnostic coordination operations.

phases.title: Project Console
phases.objective: Provide human-readable status and decision UX.

phases.title: Self-Verification
phases.objective: Stress the platform with synthetic projects and fault injection.

phases.title: Dogfooding
phases.objective: Use AD2 to manage AD2 itself.

phases.title: Release Hardening
phases.objective: Finalize migration, compatibility, docs, performance, and stable release evidence.
